name: Default
shortDescription: Web-based continuous localization platform with version control integration, backed by PostgreSQL and Valkey.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated WEBLATE_ADMIN_PASSWORD. Weblate resets the admin password to this value on every start, so change it in the environment, not in the UI.

Notifications, password resets and sign-up confirmations need an SMTP server: set WEBLATE_EMAIL_HOST, WEBLATE_EMAIL_HOST_USER and WEBLATE_EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD. Public registration is off until you set WEBLATE_REGISTRATION_OPEN to 1.
